snippet.title: Spider Land - Trailer
snippet.description:
Spider Land is a visual-novel about a man set free from the shackles of morality. The apocalypse came and went, and now all that's left to do is carry on. 

Set in the eastern suburbs of Melbourne, you'll scour the local landmarks, fending off fiends and deviants, collecting your dues, and most importantly, leaving your mark on the world. 

Releases April 15.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3246230/Spider_Land/

Follow me on Bluesky: 
https://bsky.app/profile/xavibell.bsky.social

Music by Aidan Ziccone
